title: The Role of The Other in Subject Formation
text:
Sociological theory suggests that the sense of self is not an autonomous internal construct but rather emerges through interaction with others. Specifically, the concept of 'the Other' highlights that meaning and identity are constituted within a social matrix of mutual recognition.

This dynamic implies that categories of difference—such as race, gender, or class—are not inherent biological realities but powerful discursive formations maintained by societal structures.
